Solid = proven baseline or retained P12 DNS/TLS asset. Dashed = bounded opt-in/session component, not always running.
Learning baseline: one Spot node, one replica, in-cluster PostgreSQL, raw ALB HTTP, same-day teardown. P11/P12/P13 overlays add bounded HA, trusted domain/TLS, or canary routing.
Not claimed: private multi-AZ nodes, PostgreSQL HA, WAF, or durable observability.
